expressions.r1c2: reads as cheerful 'aa' talking, though closer to an excited open-mouth pose
expressions.r1c3: reads as skeptical or doubtful more than thinking
expressions.r3c2: reads as sleepy or smug, not a clean mid-blink
expressions.r3c3: reads as a head turn of roughly 20 degrees

defects: r1c3, brows and mouth: the sharply cocked brow and unilateral lip pull create suspicion/disapproval rather than thoughtful curiosity.
r3c2, eyelids and pupils: uneven half-lidded eyes with visible pupils look sleepy and intentional; a true blink needs coordinated lid closure without changing personality.
r2c2, lower mouth and cheeks: the pasted-on wavy frown lacks convincing cheek and chin deformation, making concern feel mechanically rigged.
r2c1 and r2c3, mouth interior: teeth, tongue and lip shapes are overly broad and generic, losing the REF's restrained premium sculpting and making both poses feel stock.

Across all cells, eyes/brows/face: feature spacing and facial volumes drift between poses, especially brow height, eye aperture and jaw width, so the character feels regenerated per frame rather than one stable puppet.
top_fix: Lock a single REF-matched facial model and rebuild the expression rig around consistent eye, brow, cheek, jaw and mouth landmarks; prioritize natural mouth deformation and coordinated eyelids before adding more poses.
